description: Graphite sketch of a landscape. Simple line drawing, no shading. A large hill formation on the right side of the paper, intersects and creates a "y" formation with a smaller hill in the distance on the left. In the background, the horizon is visible.
title: Untitled (Palo Duro Canyon)
